newsitem.title: USA: 3D to appeal Aaroflex court decision.
newsitem.headline: 3D to appeal Aaroflex court decision.

text.p: 3D Systems Corp said that its patent infringement and unfair competition lawsuit against Aaroflex Inc and Albert Young has been dismissed by the Federal Court in Los Angeles.
The company issued a news release calling the development "a procedural jurisdictional matter, which we believe will be corrected on appeal."
The company said the dismissal does not relate to the merits of its case.

"Our complaint has charged the defendants with infringement of our U.S. patents, unfair competition, and falsely describing the patent coverage held by them and 3D," the news release said. "We intend to vigorously pursue this action, using all the legal remedies available to us."
